compiled_state.description:
Discovered while repairing binding-drift bug 8656-01fe-6f74-44c9 (unbound_jira REB-3510).

DEFECT: the inbound-create adopt path writes the Jira-side rebar-id:<local-id> label BEFORE the local CREATE event + binding are durably published to origin/tickets. When the pass's final tickets push is rejected (non-fast-forward) on an EPHEMERAL runner (GHA run 32602702883: 'final-push-rejected … 7 unpushed commits', runner destroyed), the local state is lost while the Jira label persists. Every automated healing path then stands down:
- binding_walk L10 guard skips adopt when the rebar-id label is present
- differ's bug-4354 suppression likewise stands down on the label
- BindingRecovery.recover_pending_bindings only walks state=='pending' store entries, which were lost with the runner

Result: a permanently stuck unbound_jira drift that only manual repair (or the fsck canary + human) can clear. This class will recur on any ephemeral-runner reconcile that loses its final push race.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
1. Ordering or recovery fix: either (a) stamp the Jira label only after the local CREATE+binding are confirmed pushed (durable publish first), or (b) extend recovery to detect marked-but-unstored keys (Jira label present, no local ticket, no binding) and replay the adopt — the exact repair performed manually for REB-3510.
2. A RED-first regression test simulating the lost-final-push runner: adopt happens, push rejected, state discarded — the next pass (or recovery) must heal the drift instead of standing down on the label.
3. bridge fsck continues to alert on the class until healed (no suppression).

Evidence and full RCA on ticket 8656-01fe-6f74-44c9; repair precedent 16c1-0f0c.
compiled_state.title: Reconcile stamps Jira rebar-id label before local adoption is durably published — push-rejected ephemeral runs strand unhealable unbound_jira drift
